title: Bulk-surface spectral homogenization with indefinite mass in periodic perforated domains
summary: We study the homogenization of an elliptic eigenvalue problem in a periodically perforated domain, where the spectral parameter appears both in the equation, through a bulk density $q$, and in a Steklov condition on the boundaries of the holes, through a surface density $ρ$, and where the resulting bulk--surface spectral measure $q\,dy+ρ\,dS_y$ is indefinite. We show that the asymptotic behavior of the spectrum depends essentially on whether the combined mean $m_{\rm eff}=\int_{Y^*}q\,dy+\int_Γρ\,dS_y$ is positive, negative, or zero.
